build_FairseqMMTask: build a FairseqMMTask instance that loads config and constructs dataset, model, and loss
load_dataset_split: load a train, valid, or test dataset split into a FairseqMMDataset wrapper
get_batch_iterator: get a batch iterator for the dataset with optional retrieval candidate building for RetriTask
add_args_taskconfig: add the taskconfig command-line argument to the fairseq argument parser
setup_task: setup and return a new FairseqMMTask instance from parsed command-line arguments
